scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Ignored customer distress and anxiety at [16:13] during delay in unbarring international calls.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer for the Australian destination phone number again at [12:01] after customer gave it clearly at [01:05].

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Deflected responsibility at [09:56] by stating routing problems in Australia were Telstra's responsibility rather than owning customer inquiry.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Spoke condescendingly to customer at [07:41] by telling her she should have checked her monthly bill insert.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to ask diagnostic probing questions regarding previous international calling patterns or handset call settings.

grader.scenario: International call barring accidentally enabled, blocking calls to family in Australia
grader.notes: Agent successfully unbarred international calling after verifying identity, but exhibited multiple customer service faults including a condescending remark regarding bill inserts, deflecting routing responsibility to Telstra, re-asking the destination number, and failing to acknowledge customer distress during an anxious delay.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net today' at [18:41].

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds were properly announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full address and security PIN at [00:43] within first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer by first name Clara naturally throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [16:13] Customer: 'I have been on this phone for over fifteen minutes while my sick mother is waiting for me to call Sydney...' ... [16:39] Agent: 'The switch update takes thirty seconds.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated international call barring issue in own words at [02:05]: 'So if I understand the situation correctly, Clara...'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:05] Customer: 'The Sydney number I am trying to call is 0061 2 9385 1199.' ... [12:01] Agent: 'What was the exact Australian telephone number you were trying to dial again?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [09:56] Agent: 'Once the call leaves the UK gateway, Telstra Australia handles the routing. Any connection problems down there are Telstra's responsibility, not ours.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [07:41] Agent: 'Well if you had actually checked your monthly bill insert last month, you would know all residential accounts had international premium calling barred by default for fraud prevention.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent did not probe into line history or international calling features.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer successfully dialled Sydney and confirmed ringing tone and connection to family at [17:24].
